sourceAliases.note: No WooCommerce plugin profile authored yet for a TikTok catalog plugin (e.g. TikTok for WooCommerce); this alias is a forward-pointer for when one is profiled.

preferredWrite.surface: Manual -- no API; merchant copies a feed link into TikTok for Business

evidence.path: wix.stores_channels.feed.v1.catalog — BuildMarketplaceCatalogFeedUrlV2Request.FeedFile enum includes TIKTOK_XML and TIKTOK_TSV (ALPHA maturity) — verified via docs-schema MCP, 2026-08-16

manualSteps.prerequisite: A TikTok for Business account with Catalog access.

steps.text: Go to Catalog > Sales Channels > TikTok Catalog in the Wix dashboard, click Get Catalog Link, and copy it.
In TikTok for Business, add the copied link as the catalog's data feed and choose a sync frequency.

manualSteps.mechanism: Pull-based, scheduled feed: the merchant sets how often TikTok re-fetches it, so product changes in Wix are NOT reflected on TikTok until the next scheduled pull — unlike Meta, which polls continuously.
